_about: Hand-written: each race's named specials, shown as 'Name: what it does' in the race tables' Other column and on the race page. 'covers' lists the effects that make up the special, by the keys tools/sync.py gives them: mod:<stat>, cond:<stat>@<when> (war, peace, vs-<race>, attack-<kind>, well_fed, overpopulated), flag:<flag>, or a race rule (homes, mirror, promote, activity, mercenary_upgrades, immune_attack:<id>, immune_rite:<id>, resist:<operation>, building_losses, roots, afflict, double_strike, momentum...). sync.py --check fails if a key doesn't match the current age's rules. Everything not covered is a bonus or a penalty by what it does.
